purpose: Conservative receipt-category checks; not an ingredient whitelist or inventory-ID catalogue.
normalization: NFKC, casefold, split compact letter/digit boundaries, punctuation to spaces. Original raw_text is never changed.
unmatched_policy: Unclassified is not non-food. Retain unmatched model candidates for the existing draft-review flow; do not silently reject groceries outside these rules.

sources.policy: ai/app/prompts/receipt.md: include human food/drink and exclude household, personal care, animal-consumption products and receipt metadata.
sources.abbreviation_review: Compound abbreviations were reviewed using the provided real receipt and retail product categories. These are not claimed to be universal retailer codes or exact online SAP aliases. No online lookup occurs during a request.

non_food_rules.reason: Battery size designation; does not match alkaline water
Reviewed oral-care description; gum alone is insufficient evidence
Detergent abbreviation with laundry/liquid context; DTG alone is insufficient evidence

food_exceptions.reason: Edible shellfish; protect from the generic razor rule
Human-consumption product; gum alone must not trigger oral-care exclusion
Drinking water, not an alkaline battery
